bottlenecks.root_cause: Default in-memory IoAdapter limited events to single pod instances
bottlenecks.remediation: Implemented RedisIoAdapter with @socket.io/redis-adapter and ioredis pub/sub

bottlenecks.symptom: Concurrent duplicate request race condition under network retries
bottlenecks.root_cause: Unhandled unique constraint rejection on concurrent insert before complete()
bottlenecks.remediation: Added catch handler for unique constraint collisions to reload existing record and return deduplicated response

bottlenecks.symptom: Lost update / overdraft race condition during simultaneous debits across multiple pods
bottlenecks.root_cause: Non-atomic find-modify-save sequence without conditional SQL decrement
bottlenecks.remediation: Implemented atomic conditional query builder decrement with WHERE balance >= :amount

bottlenecks.symptom: Hot-row contention and potential overselling under high concurrency flash checkouts
bottlenecks.root_cause: In-memory stock decrement prone to lost updates across horizontal replicas
bottlenecks.remediation: Constructed atomic update query with conditional non-negative stock invariant

bottlenecks.symptom: Cascading pod restarts during upstream database latency spikes
bottlenecks.root_cause: Liveness probe coupled to database queries instead of decoupled event-loop responsiveness
bottlenecks.remediation: Introduced dedicated /liveness, /readiness, and /startup endpoints in AppController and updated K8s manifests

bottlenecks.symptom: Dropped in-flight HTTP requests and unclosed DB/Redis handles during pod termination
bottlenecks.root_cause: app.enableShutdownHooks() was missing in main.ts bootstrap
bottlenecks.remediation: Enabled application shutdown hooks and graceful module destroy lifecycle handlers
